name: Grave Karina AP OLD

defensiveAbilities.name: Smoke Vision
defensiveAbilities.description: Smoke doesn't impair a grave karina's vision; they ignore the Concealed condition from smoke, including the ash they create with their Breath Weapon.

defensiveAbilities.name: Sound Imitation
defensiveAbilities.description: A grave karina who succeeds at a Deception check to Lie can mimic any voice they have heard. They have a +4 circumstance bonus to this check.

offensiveAbilities.name: Breath Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description: The grave karina breathes a cloud of burning ash in 30ft Cone that deals 9d8 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 30 Reflex Saving Throw save). The area becomes filled with ash for 1 round. All creatures within the cloud of ash become Concealed, and all creatures outside the cloud become concealed to creatures within it. The grave karina can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grave Blight
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 27 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 2d6 Poison Damage damage, and Sickened 1 (1 day)

Stage 3 2d8 Poison Damage damage, every hour the victim must succeed at another Fortitude save or be Confused for 1 minute, and Sickened 2 (1 day)

offensiveAbilities.name: Mocking Cry
offensiveAbilities.description: The grave karina mimics a voice and mocks a creature within 30 feet. They attempt a Deception check to Demoralize the creature. Regardless of whether the check succeeds, the target is temporarily immune to the grave karina's mocking cry for 1 hour.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shadow Command
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day Requirements The grave karina is adjacent to a creature that's casting a shadow

Effect The grave karina drives a talon into a creature's shadow and attempts to manipulate it like a puppet with the effects of Dominate(DC 27 Will Saving Throw save), except the duration is only 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

recallKnowledge: Arcana or Nature or Religion, DC 28
